acceptanceCriteria: Managed finish INT/TERM/HUP fixtures preserve complete unique gate output at a reported durable path while retaining original nonzero statuses and retiring owned descendants.
Interrupted runs never receive a green receipt; successful finish retains its existing behavior and head binding.

Owning Beamfall ticket completes its focused runner tests and required canonical make gate with source head, status and retained transcript evidence; this intake references that verified result without duplicating the execution queue.
body: Confirmed Core tooling defect observed 2026-09-30 at Beamfall Core e330036a0; installed Corvint build163 and Tasks build202. Managed roadmap finish runs the canonical Apple gate in a private temporary transcript. Five Xcode boundaries complete, then owned XCTest PID99433 stalls in default TVSnapshotStore backup metadata getxattr. After two spaced samples justify supervised SIGINT, finish exits130 and script/roadmap.sh finish_gate_exit_cleanup deletes FINISH_GATE_TRANSCRIPT before emitting or preserving it, losing3.2MB of detailed gate output. The original owned descendants were retired. Full stack samples and explicitly partial inspected excerpts survive in Beamfall .roadmap/recovery-evidence-0930/apple-ibtool-final; a later fixed cold/warm gate passed and retained full logs. This records the evidence-loss defect, not a failed implementation assertion. Dedup native transcript search found no equivalent; RMFAN-MERGE-TRAIN-PRESERVE-FAILURE-EVIDENCE-1 concerns a distinct train-worktree deletion path. Implementation is already queued in Beamfall CORE-FINISH-INTERRUPTED-TRANSCRIPT-PRESERVATION-1 (Core intake commit56bc9c7ef); preserve that project authority and do not create a competing implementation claim. This Corvint record is the machine-wide owner-required tooling intake. External scope remains incomplete/unbounded until explicitly enrolled.

completion.reason: Obsolete per decision 0544 item 4 (sha256 evidence digest; on main via batch #1277 merge 4987b7ed9): ADR-0227 deleted script/roadmap.sh and its finish_gate_exit_cleanup path. The corvint-tasks gate run interruption question is tracked as its own Corvint ticket.

title: Core managed finish discards its gate transcript on supervised interruption
